questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.

A. When the meeting will be held has not been decided.
B. Only after the rain stopped did we continue the journey.
C. Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
D. It was not until she arrived that we started the party.
options: When the meeting will be held has not been decided.
Only after the rain stopped did we continue the journey.
Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
It was not until she arrived that we started the party.
questions.answer: Only after the rain stopped did we continue the journey.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the discovery?

A. It was in the library that the historian found the ancient manuscript.
B. The ancient manuscript was found by the historian in the library.
C. The historian found the ancient manuscript, but not in the library.
D. The historian, in the library, discovered the ancient manuscript.
options: It was in the library that the historian found the ancient manuscript.
The ancient manuscript was found by the historian in the library.
The historian found the ancient manuscript, but not in the library.
The historian, in the library, discovered the ancient manuscript.
questions.answer: It was in the library that the historian found the ancient manuscript.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood in this context.

The committee insists that the proposal ________ reconsidered before the final decision.

A. must be
B. should be
C. would be
D. be
options: must be
should be
would be
be

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly demonstrates ellipsis, ensuring grammatical coherence?

A. She finished her homework, and so did he.
B. She finished her homework, and he did too.
C. She finished her homework, and he finished as well.
D. She finished her homework, and he was the same.
options: She finished her homework, and so did he.
She finished her homework, and he did too.
She finished her homework, and he finished as well.
She finished her homework, and he was the same.
questions.answer: She finished her homework, and so did he.

questions.question:
Choose the sentence that appropriately uses formal register and complex sentence structure to express a nuanced grammatical choice.

A. If the data were properly analyzed, the results would be conclusive.
B. Provided the data is properly analyzed, the results might be conclusive.
C. The data, if properly analyzed, would be conclusive.
D. Only when the data is properly analyzed, the results can be conclusive.
options: If the data were properly analyzed, the results would be conclusive.
Provided the data is properly analyzed, the results might be conclusive.
The data, if properly analyzed, would be conclusive.
Only when the data is properly analyzed, the results can be conclusive.
questions.answer: If the data were properly analyzed, the results would be conclusive.
